Granola Peanut Butter Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 18, 2010 - 11:17pm

Ingredients




1 cup all purpose white flour
1 cup whole wheat flour
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 cup dark brown sugar (packed)
1/4 cup light molasses or Karo Syrup
1 3/4 teaspoons Pure vanilla extract
3 eggs
1 1/2 cups granola
3/4 cup creamy or crunchy peanut butter
1/2 cup x to 1  butter, softened

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Combine flour, salt, and baking soda. Mix together then set aside. Cream butter, brown sugar. Add eggs, vanilla, molasses, peanut butter and granola. Stir together, mixing well. Add flour mixture and stir until all ingredients are combined. Spoon on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 15-20 minutes. 2 Makes 3 dozen
